$comment: Data (not code) that drives installer presets, file-type guessing, exit-code diagnostics and UI labels. Override the whole file with PORTAL_PRESETS_FILE=/path/to/your.json, or add/replace single exit codes with EXIT_CODE_HINTS_FILE. Keys are merged over these defaults.

InnoSetup.label: Inno Setup
InnoSetup.hint: Most common for indie/education apps. Add /DIR="C:\Path" to force an install folder.

NSIS.label: NSIS (Nullsoft)
NSIS.hint: /S is case-sensitive. The install location is passed as /D=<path> and is always added last (NSIS requirement).

MSI.label: Windows Installer (MSI)
MSI.hint: Run via msiexec /i "<file>" <args>. Add ALLUSERS=1 for machine-wide installs. Install location uses INSTALLDIR (some MSIs use TARGETDIR or APPDIR: set it in the args instead).

Portable.label: Portable (no installer)
Portable.hint: Binary (or .zip) is copied/extracted to the target path and a shortcut is created.

Custom.label: Custom / Script
Custom.hint: PowerShell (.ps1) or Batch (.bat/.cmd), or an EXE with vendor-specific flags (e.g. Squirrel: --silent).

rms-repository.label: Upload file
rms-repository.description: Stored in the bucket, served at /softwares/<file>

external_url.label: External script URL
external_url.description: Direct link to an installer or script

SYSTEM.label: SYSTEM context
SYSTEM.description: System-wide installs into Program Files. Default.

LOGGED_IN_USER.label: Logged-in user context
LOGGED_IN_USER.description: For per-user apps that install to %LOCALAPPDATA%.

exit_code_zero.label: Exit code is a success code

1.title: Generic failure
1.hint: Check the transcript for the first error line. Many installers return 1 for any failure.

2.title: File not found
2.hint: The installer or one of its dependencies is missing. Re-upload and verify the checksum.

5.title: Access denied
5.hint: Try SYSTEM context, or the app may need the logged-in user context.

740.title: Elevation required
740.hint: The installer needs admin rights. Switch the execution context to SYSTEM.

1223.title: Cancelled by user (UAC)
1223.hint: A UAC prompt was declined or blocked. Run under SYSTEM context.

1602.title: User cancelled
1602.hint: The installer showed UI. The silent arguments are probably wrong for this installer type.

1603.title: Fatal error during installation
1603.hint: Often a file in use, a pending reboot, an older version already installed, or the wrong context.

1618.title: Another installation in progress
1618.hint: Windows Installer is busy. The device will retry automatically; or click Retry later.

1619.title: Package could not be opened
1619.hint: The download may be corrupted or incomplete. Verify the checksum and re-upload.

1633.title: Unsupported platform
1633.hint: The package targets a different architecture (x86/x64/ARM).

1638.title: Another version already installed
1638.hint: Uninstall the old version first, or set detection to a file/registry check.

3010.title: Success, reboot required
3010.hint: Installed; changes take effect after the next restart.

-1.title: Process could not start or was killed
-1.hint: Usually a timeout, a missing file, or the service could not spawn the installer.

-1978335189.title: winget: no applicable installer
-1978335189.hint: No installer matches this system (architecture/scope). Try without --scope machine.

-1978335212.title: winget: no package found
-1978335212.hint: No package matched the ID. Check the exact ID with `winget search`.

-1978334967.title: winget: installer hash mismatch
-1978334967.hint: The publisher changed the installer. Retry later or pin a version.

-1978335135.title: winget: package already installed
-1978335135.hint: Treat as success, or set detection to a file/registry check.

error_patterns.title: Installer timed out
error_patterns.hint: Raise the safety timeout, or the installer is waiting for input: check the silent arguments.

error_patterns.title: Checksum mismatch
error_patterns.hint: The downloaded file differs from the upload. Check Nginx/CDN caching, then re-upload.

error_patterns.title: Download failed
error_patterns.hint: The device could not fetch the file. Check the bucket object, Nginx proxy and PUBLIC_DOWNLOAD_BASE_URL.

error_patterns.title: No logged-in user
error_patterns.hint: Per-user installs wait for someone to sign in. It will be retried on the next check-in.

error_patterns.title: Access denied
error_patterns.hint: Switch execution context, or the target folder is not writable for this account.

installer_detection.$comment: Checked in order against the start and end of the uploaded file (ASCII and UTF-16 text, or magic bytes). First match wins. silentArgs overrides the type's preset when given.
